port: supervisor allocates a new exclusive port; never 11434; never reuse external service
authentication: none: the server is bound to 127.0.0.1 and accepts unauthenticated local calls
environment: supervisor builds a minimal environment; reject inherited LLAMA_*, HF_*, proxy variables and backend search paths
context_sizing: llama-server splits --ctx-size across --parallel slots (n_ctx_slot = ctx/parallel); ctx = 32768 * parallel keeps 32768 tokens per candidate, total KV stays ctx-sized

binding_arguments.--model: explicit verified read-only model binding, complete shard group
binding_arguments.--mmproj: vision only: explicit verified compatible read-only projector binding; never inferred from GGUF extension

ownership: supervisor must verify image/hash/create-time and own Windows kill-on-close job; cancel only its own process tree

api.health: GET /health (readiness only, not authentication or identity proof)
api.text: POST /v1/chat/completions without authorization; bounded typed request/response
api.vision: POST /v1/chat/completions with text and bounded local image data URL; no remote image URL

evidence: metadata smoke is not inference, server startup, adapter integration, or clean-machine validation
